dataset.asset: S&P 500 U.S. equity index (§1 says Standard & Poor’s index; captions specify S&P 500)
dataset.market: U.S. equities, not Bitcoin or cryptocurrency
dataset.observation_frequency: monthly target, computed from daily continuously compounded returns
dataset.target_description: Log of monthly realized standard deviation computed from the sum of squared daily log returns. Not daily intraday realized variance; Eq. (1) does not center returns or divide by N_t.
dataset.daily_price_data_provider: Not explicitly identified in §1 / Table 1; do not substitute Yahoo Finance from the repository replication.
dataset.exogenous_sources: Table 1, p. 507: Shiller website (DP, EP); Kenneth French website (MKT, HML, SMB, STR); Datastream (TB, TS, DEF, INF); OECD (IP).

models.family: standalone dense feed-forward neural network, MLP family
models.input_lag_ambiguity: §3, p. 512 says independent/control variables are lagged by one year; the selected input sets on pp. 513 and 516 use (t-1). Preserve this ambiguity; do not silently assume monthly or annual exogenous lags.

models.family: standalone dense feed-forward neural network, MLP family

architecture_common.activation: §2, p. 508 describes identity output F and logistic hidden G as common choices; §3 does not separately certify the activations used in empirical fits. Do not label a sigmoid configuration as independently verified.
architecture_common.training_algorithm: Gradient descent with momentum and adaptive learning rate (gdx) backpropagation for FNN, ENN, JNN and LSTM (§3, p. 514).
architecture_common.architecture_selection: Minimum training MSE; hidden nodes searched up to 7 (full sample) or 5 (subsample), selected on training samples. A separate footnote sets LSTM to 50 hidden units.
architecture_common.weights_caveat: Reported weight counts are copied verbatim; do not reverse engineer input width from them.

evaluation.scheme: Rolling window re-estimation at each forecast origin
evaluation.five_step_definition: Iterated forecast of the target at t+5, updating lagged target inputs with previous predictions; not variance aggregated over the next five months.
evaluation.MCS: Range-statistic MCS; stationary bootstrap with 10,000 resamples. Tables 4 and 5 report average losses and MCS p-values.
evaluation.DM: Table 6 also reports DM against persistence; editorial significance legend/prose conflicts are documented below. It is not used for a clean superiority claim.
evaluation.uncertainty: There are only 22 crisis out-of-sample points; the source does not document enough to certify purging or scaler causality.

limits: This is one primary journal study on S&P 500, supporting methodological family selection. It adds zero studies to a Bitcoin-specific corpus.
The paper calls the baseline FNN and supplies an explicit dense, single hidden layer equation and Figure 3. The MLP-family mapping rests on this structure, not inference from generic deep learning.
This does not prove the current E1 configuration was derived before training. A current one hidden layer baseline may be a project simplification, not an exact replica.
Do not compare raw MSE/QLIKE with E1 daily seven-return volatility: asset, monthly frequency, target log transform, predictors, horizon and test cohort differ.
An evaluated comparator is not automatically best. Full-sample FNN loses to HAR in MSE at both horizons. Crisis-subsample FNN has the lowest reported five-step MSE in Table 5.
Do not claim frequent use from this single study.
§1 says February 1950; §3 and §4 occasionally say January 1950. Preserve the §1 count of 815 observations with its February start.
The source says exogenous variables are lagged one year, but selected input sets use t-1; this blocks an exact replica without clarification.

The narrative on p. 520 says fewer families beat persistence at one step, while Table 6 marks the FNN full-sample statistic 2.457 with stars. The significance legend maps stars to 1%, 5% and 10% in an unusual order. Do not base an MLP superiority claim on these ambiguities.

visual_QA.method: Rendered PDF pages 17 and 22 and visually checked model rows and MSE/QLIKE columns against extracted text.

reported_losses_interpretation: Tables4/5 report average out-of-sample losses over245/22 forecast observations. They are not mean±SD over300 independent benchmark seeds; the300 random starts belong to source fitting/architecture selection.
